title: AASM Multi-Objective Problem
description: v0.52 ordered multi-objective problem. Objective tolerance is normative for both lexicographic survivor admission and Pareto dominance: values within tolerance are treated as not strictly better/worse for that objective according to its sense.

tolerance.description: Normative objective tolerance. Lexicographic stages retain values within tolerance of the stage optimum. Pareto dominance requires no-worse comparison within tolerance and strict improvement beyond tolerance on at least one objective.
